args.body:
Dear Emma,

Your trip to Paris and London has been successfully booked! Here are all the details:

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PARIS (July 15-20, 2024)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏨 HOTEL: Le Marais Boutique
   Address: 12 Rue des Archives, 75004 Paris, France
   Price: $120-180/night
   Rating: 4.2/5
   Reviews: Charming boutique hotel in the heart of Le Marais. Beautifully decorated rooms with modern amenities. Friendly and attentive staff.

🚗 CAR RENTAL: Paris Rent-a-Car
   Address: 23 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   Price: $45/day
   Rating: 4.5/5
   Reviews: Great service and well-maintained vehicles. Convenient location near the Louvre. Staff was helpful and spoke English.

🍽️ RESTAURANT RESERVATION: Le Baratin
   Address: 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France
   Cuisine: French
   Price: $30/person
   Rating: 4.8/5 (Highest rated!)
   Reviews: Small, cozy bistro with delicious, homestyle cooking. Daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients. Natural wine selection. Cash only.
   Date: July 16, 2024 at 7:00 PM

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LONDON (July 20-25, 2024)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🏨 HOTEL: London Luxury
   Address: 10 Park Lane, London W1K 1LB, United Kingdom
   Price: $80-150/night
   Rating: 5.0/5
   Reviews: Exquisite luxury hotel with impeccable service. Stunning views of the city skyline. Spacious and elegantly designed rooms.

🚗 CAR RENTAL: New Car Rental
   Address: 123 Oxford Street, London W1D 2HG, United Kingdom
   Price: $50/day
   Rating: 4.5/5
   Reviews: Wide range of vehicles to choose from. Competitive prices.

🍽️ RESTAURANT RESERVATION: House of Sushi
   Address: 456 Regent Street, London, UK
   Cuisine: Italian
   Price: $40/person
   Rating: 4.5/5
   Reviews: Authentic Italian cuisine with fresh ingredients. Wide selection of pasta and pizza dishes. Charming and cozy ambiance.
   Date: July 21, 2024 at 7:00 PM

✈️ FLIGHT: Paris to London
   Airline: British Airways
   Flight: BA123
   Date: July 20, 2024
   Departure: 9:00 AM from Paris
   Arrival: 11:00 AM in London
   Price: $200

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
IMPORTANT NOTES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. The hotel reviews mentioned a "Grand Hyatt" booking for July 15-20, but this hotel was not found in our available options. I've booked Le Marais Boutique instead, which is a highly-rated boutique hotel in central Paris.

2. All reservations are confirmed and added to your calendar.

3. Please bring cash for Le Baratin as they are cash only.

4. For Le Baratin and Bistrot Paul Bert, reservations are recommended/essential.

5. Breizh Café is known for the best crepes in Paris - consider visiting if you have time!

Enjoy your trip to Paris and London!

Best regards,
